group.tooltip: Empty = all; accepts group names / indices / 0-10:2 / @P.y > 0

pcg_ui.label: Attribute
pcg_ui.help: In Adjust mode, giving an attribute randomizes per piece (same offset within a piece)

group.tooltip: Only scatter on these faces; empty = all

pcg_ui.label: Density Scale
pcg_ui.help: Point count = Density Scale × weighted total area; not used while Force Total Count is on

area_attribute.tooltip: used in place of the prim's geometric area

pcg_ui.label: Use Geometric Normals
pcg_ui.help: Output N uses the geometric normal of the containing triangle, not the interpolated source point normal N; independent of whether Relax is on. Without N on the source, the geometric normal is used anyway

pcg_ui.label: Interpolate Source Attributes
pcg_ui.help: Interpolates the source's point attributes onto the scattered points (vertex attributes are not governed by this toggle; see Vertex Attributes on the Attributes tab)

pcg_ui.label: Generate
pcg_ui.help: Scatter on Voxels Independently is not implemented: this node does not scatter into volumes

count_per_prim_attribute.tooltip: An integer, or the name of an integer prim attribute (Count per Primitive)

texture_uv_attribute.tooltip: uv used by Density Texture / In Texture Space

pcg_ui.label: UV Attribute
pcg_ui.help: uv used by Density Texture, In Texture Space and texture-space output

pcg_ui.label: Output Radius Attribute
pcg_ui.help: 0.537/√density, clamped to Max Relax Radius when that is on

pcg_ui.label: Output Radius and Density in Texture Space
Thread Width
pcg_ui.help: With Separate on, only controls the warp (vertical); 1 − line width = gap

pcg_ui.label: Line Width
pcg_ui.help: Pixels

pcg_ui.hide: { kind == checker } { kind == uv_grid } { kind == julia } { kind == chladni }

pcg_ui.label: Resolution X
pcg_ui.help: Used when no cop is wired; with a cop wired, follows its resolution

pcg_ui.label: Header Interval
pcg_ui.help: One header course every this many rows

pcg_ui.label: Amplitude Ratio
pcg_ui.help: Weight of wave b relative to wave a; 1 = the original formula

pcg_ui.label: Density
pcg_ui.help: Cells whose random number ≥ Density are culled (mask set to 0); 1 = keep all

pcg_ui.label: Outline Width
pcg_ui.help: Pixels

pcg_ui.label: Marker Size
pcg_ui.help: Relative to the cell's short side

pcg_ui.label: Pattern Layer
pcg_ui.help: A layer on the input cop; center of each crossing > 0.5 = warp on top

pcg_ui.label: Amplitude
pcg_ui.hide: { range_values == min_max } { range_values == min_range } { range_values == middle_range }

vexpression.tooltip: Compute one vector per element and add it to Offset

pcg_ui.label: Warp Distance
pcg_ui.help: 0 = no distortion; the two parameters below only take effect when it is non-zero

pcg_ui.label: Blend Attribute
pcg_ui.help: When non-empty, used per element as Blend (the constant above no longer applies)

pcg_ui.label: Range Length
pcg_ui.help: Middle ± Range Length is the full width (unlike Attribute Adjust's half width)

pcg_ui.label: Initial Merge
pcg_ui.help: How to merge with an existing group of the same name; with no such group, all behave like Replace

pcg_ui.label: Base Group
pcg_ui.help: Starting set, empty = unrestricted (starts from the empty set when only Include by Edges is on); the Keep tabs intersect with it, Include by Edges is unioned in last

pcg_ui.label: Include Partially Contained Entities
pcg_ui.help: A primitive / vertex counts if any one of its points is inside the box (off: all points must be inside)

pcg_ui.label: Spread Angle
pcg_ui.help: 180 = include all

pcg_ui.label: Combine
pcg_ui.help: Include works as in Houdini: edges picked by the edge rules join the group regardless of other tabs; Keep is an extra of this plugin, intersected with the previous result

pcg_ui.label: Unshared Edges
pcg_ui.help: Boundary edges (only one adjacent primitive); unioned with the angle rule

pcg_ui.label: Edge Angle
pcg_ui.help: Edges whose adjacent primitives' normals differ by Min ~ Max degrees; selected independently of Unshared, then unioned

pcg_ui.label: Frequency
pcg_ui.help: uv × Frequency; the reciprocal of Houdini's Element Size

pcg_ui.label: Center
pcg_ui.help: Constant added to the result (Center in Houdini's Range section)

pcg_ui.label: Channels
pcg_ui.help: 1~4; each channel gets a different seed (seed + k×7919)

pcg_ui.label: Tile U
pcg_ui.help: Seamless in u; cannot be on together with Loop Frames > 0

device.tooltip: auto=GPU only with CUDA and pixel count >= 256²; exact=numpy float64, bit-identical to the geometry side but slowest

pcg_ui.label: Time Scale
pcg_ui.help: Goes 4D (animated) only when > 0; 0 = static, Time / Loop Frames have no effect

pcg_ui.label: Jitter
pcg_ui.help: 0 = regular grid; > 1 runs outside the search range (Houdini warns too)

pcg_ui.label: Tile V
pcg_ui.help: On together with Tile U = seamless in both directions (4D flat torus); Torus has it built in

pcg_ui.label: Bias
pcg_ui.help: Perlin bias; 0.5 = no change; < 0.5 pulls toward 0, > 0.5 pulls toward 1

pcg_ui.label: Gain
pcg_ui.help: Perlin gain; 0.5 = no change

pcg_ui.label: Gamma
pcg_ui.help: x^γ: > 1 darkens (per the Houdini noise docs)

pcg_ui.label: Contrast
pcg_ui.help: scale around 0.5

pcg_ui.label: Rotate
pcg_ui.help: In degrees; the three angles are applied in Rotate Order

pcg_ui.label: Group
pcg_ui.help: Group Type is fixed to Guess: first tried as a point group / point attribute expression; if nothing matches on points, as a primitive group (takes those primitives' points)

rotate_order.tooltip: Rotation order: xyz = X first, then Y, then Z (Houdini default)

pcg_ui.label: Transform Order
pcg_ui.help: Applied left to right

pcg_ui.label: Shear Xy
pcg_ui.help: XY / XZ / YZ: x += xy·y + xz·z, y += yz·z (applied right after scale)

pcg_ui.label: Px
pcg_ui.help: Scale / rotate happen around this point

pcg_ui.label: Prx
pcg_ui.help: Scale / rotate happen in a frame rotated by these angles

group.tooltip: Empty = all; accepts group names / indices / 0-10:2 / @P.y > 0

pcg_ui.label: Distance
pcg_ui.help: Not used when a spine is wired and External Spine is on; the length comes from the spine

pcg_ui.label: Twist
pcg_ui.help: No effect when a spine is wired and External Spine is on

pcg_ui.label: Specified Direction
pcg_ui.help: Off: along the primitive normal (Houdini's Primitive Normal); on: all points move in the same direction

pcg_ui.label: External Spine
pcg_ui.help: Sweeps along the spine only when on and a curve is wired into the spine input; otherwise a straight extrude

pcg_ui.label: Distance Scale
pcg_ui.help: Point (or primitive) attribute, multiplies Distance per point; not used in external spine mode

pcg_ui.label: Rotate
pcg_ui.help: Rotation around the extrusion direction (degrees)

pcg_ui.label: Scale
pcg_ui.help: Uniform scale about the front centroid

pcg_ui.label: Output Geometry and Groups
pcg_ui.help: Off = this section uses defaults: outputs front + sides, groups extrudeFront / extrudeSide

pcg_ui.label: Front Seam Group
pcg_ui.help: The ring of points where the sides meet the front; empty = not output

pcg_ui.label: Back Seam Group
pcg_ui.help: The ring of points where the sides meet the back; empty = not output

pcg_ui.label: Generate Unwrapped Texture Coordinates for Sides
Extrusion Mode
pcg_ui.help: Point Normal: each point moves along its own point normal (N attribute, computed if missing); no effect when Direction is on or a Spine is wired

pcg_ui.label: Albedo Layer
pcg_ui.help: Empty = white

pcg_ui.label: Shadows
pcg_ui.help: Shadows require a Height Layer; Directional uses Height to Shadow, Point marches pixel by pixel from each pixel toward the light

points.tooltip: One new point per line: x y z (commas work too); lines starting with # are comments

pcg_ui.label: Points
pcg_ui.help: One new point per line: x y z; appended after the existing points

pcg_ui.label: Delete Geometry But Keep the Points

pattern.tooltip: One polygon per line: 0-3 / 5 2 7 / 0-20:3; negative numbers count from the end

attribute.tooltip: points with the same value are connected into one

custom_ramp.tooltip: Used when color_ramp is custom. position:r,g,b

pcg_ui.help: Colors by the range and color ramp below only when a name is given
